evaluation_role: Previously inspected retrospective initial index-only benchmark, not a new trained classifier or prospective test
availability: Same assumed calendar-day publication delays as prior research; actual historical publication/identity times not reconstructed
rebuild: Rebuild joint horse/jockey indices from only full linked fields whose result availability <= target cutoff and off < cutoff
index_settings: Unchanged ACTOR_INDICES_PROTOCOL.json settings; no tuning on evaluation outcomes
combination: Arithmetic mean of the horse and jockey 0-100 indices; equal weights, no optimized weights
ordered: Three highest finish_performance indices in descending order
ties: Round comparison scores to 8 decimals, then lower horse number; count tied-leading races explicitly
unknown: Unobserved adjusted index stays marked missing; 50 is only the explicit ranking prior. Do not drop missing-index races or treat the prior as observed skill
cohort: Exact same 3329 races in 2025 and 2707 races in 2026 as saved evidence-rank comparison, all eligible races included
baseline: Saved evidence_rank predictions, baseline=prior rank model, candidate=2024-selected evidence calibration
pair: Pair residual index excluded from this initial benchmark; it is not a calibrated win/top3 contribution
solver: Warm-start coordinate descent on the same ridge objective, maximum 80 iterations per changed history set; verify against cold as-of reference
forbidden: No present-day entity catalogue joined onto historical races; no target outcomes, final odds or payouts in ranking; no best-rule selection using 2025/2026
promotion: Report all three rules; no production model replacement or automatic adoption
